title: Private client follow-up notes
users: Freelancers managing their own client follow-ups
problem: Follow-up notes are scattered, making the next client action difficult to find.
desired_outcome: A freelancer can record a client follow-up and find their next due action in one place.
in_scope: Manual creation and editing of client notes with a follow-up date
A list of upcoming follow-ups ordered by date

success_criteria.criterion: An authenticated user can save a note with a client and follow-up date, then find it after reloading.
success_criteria.verification: Exercise create, reload, and read in a browser acceptance test.

success_criteria.criterion: Another user cannot list or retrieve the owner’s notes.
success_criteria.verification: Use two test users and verify list isolation and denied direct-ID access.

success_criteria.criterion: The upcoming list places an earlier follow-up before a later one.
success_criteria.verification: Create two dated notes and assert their displayed order.

constraints: The first version must work in a browser.

decisions.answer: Freelancers managing their own client follow-ups.
Personal use only; no shared workspaces in the first version.

assumptions.statement: Freelancers will find a manual follow-up list useful; this is not yet customer-validated.
assumptions.impact: Validate usefulness with target users before committing to a broader roadmap.

next_action: Select and verify the GitHub repository and Project, then plan small development slices and publish their Issues and Project items.
